messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High GPU queue depth observed for inference-cluster-prod. autoscaler health checks failing. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Paging @sara (on-call). Severity: P1. Symptom: bounded capacity on GPU fleet, 95th perc token latency spiking, 500s inqueue.

sara: I got the page, looking now. First glance: metrics from metrics-server/adapter show `k8s_custom_metrics_adapter_down` and prometheus scraping lag.

devon: seeing same in the console — autoscaler HPA target isn't updating. pods at 100% GPU utilization, queue length growing. Examples of queued items: inference requests from customer A and B.

nate: grepping logs: prometheus-adapter shows timeouts to Prometheus: `Get "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query": context deadline exceeded`. Prom still up but scraping delayed ~4m.

li: can we confirm if this is region-specific? infra-eng: any infra events in us-west-2?

infra-eng: no maintenance in us-west-2. Network looks fine, no node terminations. Disk IO normal.

ops-bot: Automated mitigation suggestions: 1) scale GPU ASG manually 2) enable fallback-model-route 3) pause low-priority queues. Use `ops scale` or Console.

sara: I'll try manual scale first to relieve queue while we fix metrics adapter. devon, can you open console and increase GPU pool by 6 nodes (estimated)?

devon: scaling +6 nodes now. K8s deploys new nodes to nodepool-gpu-2, starting.

customer-ops: Customer A is reporting 5xx errors and timeouts; their SLA alerts are firing. They're asking for ETA.

sara: telling them we're mitigating by increasing capacity and investigating the autoscaling pipeline. ETA ~20-30m to see capacity come up and queue drain.

nate: while nodes come up, I'll restart prometheus-adapter and metrics-server to flush stuck metrics. Commands: 
```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/metrics-server
```
Will watch adapter logs for errors.

li: good. Also toggle HPA to use raw CPU/GPU utilization as a temporary measure instead of custom metrics. We have HPA fallback configs in the doc.

devon: nodes are provisioning, kubelet join happening. New GPU pods being scheduled but image pulls are a bit slow.

nate: prometheus-adapter logs: adapter started, fetching rules, now returning metrics. Prom scrape backlog shows ~5min gap recovered. HPA controller reported updated replicas at 2:14:20.

sara: Did HPA pick up updates? Check `kubectl get hpa -n inference` and describe.

devon: HPA now shows desired=+8, current=12, updated at 2:14:40. Queue length decreasing from 3400 -> 600 in last 8 minutes.

ops-bot: Reminder: lower-priority queues still processing; consider pausing batch jobs to speed recovery.

sara: Pausing non-urgent batch jobs now (job-runner:paused=true).

customer-ops: Customer A reports degraded latency still but error rate down from 40% to 8%. They asked how long until full recovery.

sara: Expect full recovery in 10-15m once all pods warmed and KV caches repopulate. We'll keep them updated.

nate: Follow-up: prometheus adapter root cause appears to be intermittent high query latency from Prometheus due to a bad TSDB compaction during 01:58-02:04 UTC; adapter hit timeouts and temporarily returned empty metrics, which left HPA not scaling. Restarting adapter and metrics-server allowed HPA to reconcile.

li: action: add alerting for `prometheus_query_duration_seconds` over threshold and also make the autoscaler fallback to node-level metrics after X minutes of missing custom metrics.

devon: I also deployed a temporary circuit-breaker in routing: fallback to smaller CPU-only model for non-critical traffic. That shaved off ~25% of remaining queue. config snippet:
```
route:
  fallback_model: small-cpu-v1
  apply_to: tags != "high_priority"
```

ops-bot: Post-incident checklist: 1) create incident doc 2) link metrics snapshots 3) run RCA w/ storage team on TSDB compaction 4) schedule runbook update for HPA fallback.

sara: I'll open the incident doc and assign owners: Nate for Prometheus RCA, Li for HPA/fallback runbook, Devon for capacity automation improvements. Customer comms: I'll send a summary to Customer A and B.

customer-ops: Thanks, appreciate the quick response.

infra-eng: FYI -- increased retention for Prometheus compaction tune is scheduled as part of RCA next week.

sara: Closing alerts as recovered. Filing postmortem and linking to this thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
